```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("../../../../core/framework/R/framework_init.R")
```

```{r set-json-path, include=FALSE}
GAZETTEER_JSON_FILE <- "russian_core_principalities_settlements.json"
```

```{r load-stadester-json, include=FALSE}
gaz_map <- jsonlite::fromJSON(GAZETTEER_JSON_FILE, simplifyVector = FALSE)
settlements_list <- unname(gaz_map)

# Sort chronologically by first occupied year, then alphabetically by name
first_year_num <- function (arg0_s) {
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(arg0_s$population))
  if (length(yrs) == 0) return(99999)
  return(min(yrs))
}
last_year_num <- function (arg0_s) {
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(arg0_s$population))
  if (length(yrs) == 0) return(-99999)
  return(max(yrs))
}

ord_idx <- order(
  vapply(settlements_list, first_year_num, numeric(1)),
  vapply(settlements_list, function (s) as.character(s$name), character(1))
)
settlements_list <- settlements_list[ord_idx]

translit_cyr <- function (arg0_str) {
  s <- as.character(arg0_str)
  if (!nzchar(s)) return("")
  cyr <- c(
    "А","Б","В","Г","Д","Е","Ё","Ж","З","И","Й","К","Л","М","Н","О","П","Р","С","Т","У","Ф","Х","Ц","Ч","Ш","Щ","Ъ","Ы","Ь","Э","Ю","Я",
    "а","б","в","г","д","е","ё","ж","з","и","й","к","л","м","н","о","п","р","с","т","у","ф","х","ц","ч","ш","щ","ъ","ы","ь","э","ю","я"
  )
  lat <- c(
    "A","B","V","G","D","E","Yo","Zh","Z","I","Y","K","L","M","N","O","P","R","S","T","U","F","Kh","Ts","Ch","Sh","Shch","","Y","","E","Yu","Ya",
    "a","b","v","g","d","e","yo","zh","z","i","y","k","l","m","n","o","p","r","s","t","u","f","kh","ts","ch","sh","shch","","y","","e","yu","ya"
  )
  for (i in seq_along(cyr)) {
    s <- gsub(cyr[i], lat[i], s, fixed = TRUE)
  }
  return(s)
}

fmt_other_names <- function (arg0_s) {
  onames <- unlist(arg0_s$other_names)
  if (length(onames) == 0) return("-")
  clean_vec <- unique(vapply(onames, translit_cyr, character(1)))
  clean_vec <- clean_vec[nzchar(clean_vec) & tolower(clean_vec) != tolower(arg0_s$name)]
  if (length(clean_vec) == 0) {
    clean_vec <- unique(vapply(onames, translit_cyr, character(1)))
  }
  return(paste(head(clean_vec, 2L), collapse = "; "))
}

fmt_year_lbl <- function (arg0_y) {
  y <- as.numeric(arg0_y)
  if (y < 0) return(paste0(abs(round(y)), "BC"))
  return(paste0(round(y), "AD"))
}

fmt_span <- function (arg0_s) {
  y1 <- first_year_num(arg0_s)
  y2 <- last_year_num(arg0_s)
  if (y1 == y2) return(fmt_year_lbl(y1))
  if (y1 < 0 && y2 < 0) return(paste0(abs(y1), "-", abs(y2), "BC"))
  if (y1 > 0 && y2 > 0) return(paste0(y1, "-", y2, "AD"))
  return(paste0(fmt_year_lbl(y1), " - ", fmt_year_lbl(y2)))
}

fmt_num_eu <- function (arg0_val) {
  if (is.null(arg0_val) || is.na(arg0_val)) return("-")
  v <- as.numeric(arg0_val)
  if (v >= 1000) {
    s <- sprintf("%.1fk", v / 1000.0)
    s <- gsub("\\.", ",", s)
    return(s)
  }
  return(as.character(round(v)))
}

fmt_coord_pair <- function (arg0_coords) {
  lat <- gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", as.numeric(arg0_coords[[1]])))
  lon <- gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", as.numeric(arg0_coords[[2]])))
  return(paste0(lat, "°N, ", lon, "°E"))
}

fmt_pop_series <- function (arg0_s, arg1_ymin = -99999, arg2_ymax = 99999) {
  pop_map <- arg0_s$population
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(pop_map))
  vals <- as.numeric(unlist(pop_map))
  keep <- which(yrs >= arg1_ymin & yrs <= arg2_ymax)
  if (length(keep) == 0) return("-")
  parts <- vapply(keep, function (idx) {
    paste0(fmt_year_lbl(yrs[idx]), ": ", fmt_num_eu(vals[idx]))
  }, character(1))
  return(paste(parts, collapse = "; "))
}

get_pop_window_val <- function (arg0_s, arg1_ymin, arg2_ymax) {
  pop_map <- arg0_s$population
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(pop_map))
  vals <- as.numeric(unlist(pop_map))
  keep <- which(yrs >= arg1_ymin & yrs <= arg2_ymax)
  if (length(keep) == 0) return("-")
  idx <- keep[which.max(yrs[keep])]
  return(fmt_num_eu(vals[idx]))
}
```

# Overview

This supplementary report presents the tabular settlement gazetteer (`russian_core_principalities_settlements.json`) accompanying the regional demographic review of the Russian Core Principalities (`russian_core_principalities_areal_masks_and_bins.pdf`). The JSON dataset contains 258 individual settlements across the eight regional clusters of European Russia (Novgorod and the Russian North, Vladimir-Suzdal and Rostov-Yaroslavl, Moscow and Tver, Ryazan and the Upper Oka, Smolensk and the Upper Dnieper, the Bryansk-Kursk-Voronezh Forest-Steppe, Nizhny Novgorod-Vyatka-Great Perm, and the Middle Volga and Cis-Urals) from 10000BC to 1900AD, formatted in the `population_Stadester` structure (keyed by `"<Name>-Russia"`, with `name`, `other_names`, `coords`, `country`, `key` and positive-integer `population` maps).

Population figures are compiled from excavated dwelling floors and settlement plans for Mesolithic, Neolithic, Bronze Age and Early Iron Age sites [@Zhilin2019; @Oshibkina2006; @Kostyleva2014; @Kostyleva2022; @Nordqvist2020; @Engovatova2021], walled urban footprints (`detinets` and `okolny gorod`) and unfortified `posad` areas for Kievan Rus, Volga Bulgaria and Golden Horde towns [@Tikhomirov1956; @Kuza1989; @Kuza1996; @Nosov1990; @Darkevich1995; @Eniosova2012; @Khuzin2001; @Rudenko2012; @Nedashkovsky2000; @Belorybkin2022; @Belavin2023], and Muscovite cadastral books (`pistsovye knigi`), Imperial poll-tax revisions (`revizii`) and the 1897 First General Census for early modern and nineteenth-century towns [@Kopanev1959; @Shapiro1971; @Vodarsky1973; @Vodarsky1977; @Kabuzan1963; @Kabuzan1971; @Rashin1956; @Mironov2000; @Troynitsky1905].

# Prehistoric, Bronze Age, and Early Iron Age Settlements (10000BC - 800AD)

```{r tab-rc-ancient, results='asis'}
ancient_list <- Filter(function (s) first_year_num(s) <= 800, settlements_list)

df_ancient <- do.call(rbind, lapply(ancient_list, function (s) {
  data.frame(
    Settlement = s$name,
    Other_Names = fmt_other_names(s),
    Coords = fmt_coord_pair(s$coords),
    Span = fmt_span(s),
    Pop_History = fmt_pop_series(s, -10000, 800),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

render_table_template(
  df_ancient,
  list(
    caption = "Prehistoric, Neolithic, Bronze Age and Early Iron Age settlements of the Russian Core (10000BC - 800AD) compiled from russian_core_principalities_settlements.json.",
    label = "tab:rc-ancient",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Alternative Names", "Coords", "Occupied Span", "Population Estimates by Date"),
    scale_to_fit = FALSE
  )
)
```

# Kievan Rus, Volga Bulgaria, and Golden Horde Settlements (850 - 1500AD)

```{r tab-rc-medieval, results='asis'}
med_list <- Filter(function (s) {
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(s$population))
  any(yrs >= 850 & yrs <= 1500)
}, settlements_list)

df_med <- do.call(rbind, lapply(med_list, function (s) {
  data.frame(
    Settlement = s$name,
    Other_Names = fmt_other_names(s),
    Coords = fmt_coord_pair(s$coords),
    P_950_1000 = get_pop_window_val(s, 850, 1020),
    P_1150 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1080, 1170),
    P_1200_1235 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1180, 1236),
    P_1300_1350 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1250, 1360),
    P_1400_1500 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1390, 1510),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

render_table_template(
  df_med,
  list(
    caption = "Medieval Kievan Rus, Volga Bulgaria, Great Perm and Golden Horde settlements of the Russian Core (850 - 1500AD) compiled from russian_core_principalities_settlements.json.",
    label = "tab:rc-medieval",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Historical Names", "Coords", "1000AD", "1150AD", "1200-1235AD", "1300-1350AD", "1500AD"),
    scale_to_fit = FALSE
  )
)
```

# Muscovite and Imperial Settlements (1550 - 1900AD)

```{r tab-rc-modern, results='asis'}
mod_list <- Filter(function (s) {
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(s$population))
  any(yrs >= 1550)
}, settlements_list)

df_mod <- do.call(rbind, lapply(mod_list, function (s) {
  data.frame(
    Settlement = s$name,
    Other_Names = fmt_other_names(s),
    Coords = fmt_coord_pair(s$coords),
    P_1600 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1550, 1650),
    P_1700 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1670, 1725),
    P_1800 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1780, 1825),
    P_1850 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1840, 1865),
    P_1897 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1895, 1898),
    P_1900 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1899, 1905),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

render_table_template(
  df_mod,
  list(
    caption = "Muscovite and Imperial urban centres, fortress towns and provincial capitals of the Russian Core (1550 - 1900AD) compiled from russian_core_principalities_settlements.json.",
    label = "tab:rc-modern",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Alternative Names", "Coords", "1600AD", "1700AD", "1800AD", "1850AD", "1897AD", "1900AD"),
    scale_to_fit = FALSE
  )
)
```

# Complete Settlement Gazetteer

```{r tab-rc-all, results='asis'}
df_all <- do.call(rbind, lapply(settlements_list, function (s) {
  data.frame(
    Key = s$key,
    Coords = fmt_coord_pair(s$coords),
    Span = fmt_span(s),
    Pop_Series = fmt_pop_series(s),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

render_table_template(
  df_all,
  list(
    caption = "Complete directory of all 258 settlement entries and population series in russian_core_principalities_settlements.json (10000BC - 1900AD).",
    label = "tab:rc-all",
    col_names = c("Stadester Key", "Coords", "Occupied Span", "Complete Population Series (Year: Population)"),
    scale_to_fit = FALSE
  )
)
```
